dependency_edges.handoff: Steady energy and boundary coefficients supply the transient heat equation.
Analytical heat solution identifies missing bulk motion, motivating convection-diffusion.
Numerical fields provide average-error and uniformity metrics for comparison.
Comparison metrics become the PID error signal and control target.
Average-temperature forcing is extended to spatially distributed inlet control.
Heat-map improvement becomes the final user strategy.
